cleaning.definition: The act of making something clean.

filling.definition: (dentistry) a dental appliance consisting of any of various substances (as metal or plastic) inserted into a prepared cavity in a tooth.

extraction.definition: The action of taking out something (especially using effort or force).

root-canal.definition: A narrow passage inside a tooth’s root lets nerves and blood vessels reach its soft inner chamber.
root-canal.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «رووت كانال»

crown.definition: The part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel.

bridge.definition: A structure built over water or a low place for people to cross.

implant.definition: To fix or set securely or deeply.

bonding.definition: (dentistry) a technique for repairing a tooth.

sealant.definition: A kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface).

veneer.definition: A thin covering placed over the front of a tooth to improve its appearance.

inlay.definition: (dentistry) a filling consisting of a solid substance (as gold or porcelain) fitted to a cavity in a tooth and cemented into place.

onlay.definition: A custom dental restoration that covers part of a damaged tooth, including one or more raised chewing surfaces, without covering the entire crown.
onlay.exampleUsage: The dentist explained that an onlay could restore the damaged chewing surface.

gum-graft.definition: A dental surgical procedure in which tissue is added to an area of the gums, often to cover exposed tooth roots or rebuild gum tissue.
gum-graft.exampleUsage: The periodontist discussed whether a gum graft was appropriate for the patient.

bone-graft.definition: A medical or dental procedure in which bone or bone-like material is placed to help repair or rebuild an area of bone.
bone-graft.exampleUsage: The oral surgeon explained the purpose of the bone graft.

tooth-reshaping.definition: A dental procedure in which a professional carefully changes a small amount of tooth enamel to alter shape or smooth an edge.
tooth-reshaping.exampleUsage: The dentist discussed tooth reshaping as one possible cosmetic option.

abscess-drainage.definition: A clinical procedure in which a healthcare professional releases fluid or pus from an abscess to treat infection.
abscess-drainage.exampleUsage: The dentist said abscess drainage must be performed by a qualified professional.

fluoride-treatment.definition: A professional dental treatment that applies concentrated fluoride to teeth to help strengthen enamel and reduce decay risk.
fluoride-treatment.exampleUsage: The hygienist provided a fluoride treatment after the cleaning.

drill.definition: A tool with a rotating bit used for making holes.
drill.exampleUsage: The drill was used during the activity.

probe.definition: An inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities.

scaler.definition: An electronic pulse counter used to count pulses that occur too rapidly to be recorded individually.

suction.definition: To remove or draw away by the force of suction.

x-ray-machine.definition: A device that produces X-rays for diagnostic imaging under controlled safety procedures.
x-ray-machine.exampleUsage: The dental X-ray machine was operated by trained staff.

curing-light.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «كورينج ليغت»
curing-light.definition: A light used to harden certain dental fillings and adhesives.

forceps.definition: An extractor consisting of a pair of pincers used in medical treatment (especially for the delivery of babies).

impression-tray.definition: A holder used to take a mold of the teeth and gums.

polisher.definition: A power tool used to buff surfaces.
polisher.exampleUsage: The polisher was used during the activity.

elevator.definition: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.
elevator.exampleUsage: The elevator was used during the activity.

luxator.definition: A thin dental tool used to loosen a tooth before removal.

periosteal-elevator.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «بيريوستيال يليفاتور»
periosteal-elevator.definition: A dental tool used to lift soft tissue away from bone.

bone-file.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «بوني فيلي»
bone-file.definition: A dental instrument used to smooth rough edges of bone.

dental-handpiece.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «دينتال هاندبييكي»
dental-handpiece.definition: A powered dental tool that holds a drill or other rotating tip.

ultrasonic-scaler.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «ولتراسونيك سكالير»
ultrasonic-scaler.definition: A dental tool that uses vibration to remove deposits from teeth.

apex-locator.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «ابيكس لوكاتور»
apex-locator.definition: A device used to measure the length of a tooth's root canal.

molar.definition: Grinding tooth with a broad crown.

incisor.definition: A tooth for cutting or gnawing.

canine.definition: Of or relating to a pointed conical tooth.

wisdom-tooth.definition: One of the last molar teeth to grow at the back of the mouth.

gum.definition: Soft tissue around the base of the teeth.

enamel.definition: Hard white substance covering the crown of a tooth.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

nerve.definition: Any bundle of nerve fibers running to various organs and tissues of the body.

jaw.definition: The bones and muscles of the mouth used for biting and chewing.

palate.definition: The upper surface of the mouth that separates the oral and nasal cavities.

premolar.definition: A tooth having two cusps or points.

bicuspid.definition: Having two cusps or points (especially a molar tooth).

gingiva.definition: The tissue (covered by mucous membrane) of the jaws that surrounds the bases of the teeth.
gingiva.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Gingiva" in an educational description.

alveolar-bone.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «الفيولار بوني»
alveolar-bone.definition: The part of the jawbone that holds tooth roots in place.

dental-pulp.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «دينتال بولب»
dental-pulp.definition: Soft tissue inside a tooth containing nerves and blood vessels.

tooth-socket.definition: A bony hollow in the alveolar ridge, the raised part of the jaw, anchors a tooth.

dental-arch.definition: The curved arrangement of teeth in the upper or lower jaw.

maxilla.definition: The jaw in vertebrates that is fused to the cranium.

mandible.definition: The jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth.

braces.definition: An appliance that corrects dental irregularities.

retainer.definition: A dental appliance that holds teeth (or a prosthesis) in position after orthodontic treatment.

aligner.definition: A removable clear tray used to gradually move teeth into position.

bracket.definition: A small piece attached to a tooth to hold an orthodontic wire.

rubber-band.definition: A flexible loop used to hold things together.
rubber-band.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «روببير باند»

spacer.definition: A small component holds two parts at a set distance from each other.

expander.definition: An electronic device that increases the dynamic range of the audio signal.
expander.exampleUsage: The expander was used during the activity.

headgear.definition: An external orthodontic appliance used to guide jaw or tooth movement.

mold.definition: A container used to give a material a particular shape.

ceramic-braces.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «كيراميك براكيس»
ceramic-braces.definition: Orthodontic braces with tooth-colored or clear brackets.

lingual-braces.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «لينجوال براكيس»
lingual-braces.definition: Braces fixed to the inner surfaces of the teeth.

invisalign.definition: A brand of clear removable trays used to straighten teeth.

bite-plate.definition: A removable dental device worn against the palate to diagnose or treat problems with the teeth or jaw.
bite-plate.exampleUsage: The bite plate was used during the activity.

power-chain.definition: An elastic orthodontic chain connected across braces to apply controlled force to teeth.
power-chain.exampleUsage: The orthodontist replaced the power chain during the appointment.

ligature.definition: A metal band used to attach a reed to the mouthpiece of a clarinet or saxophone.

archwire.definition: The wire in braces that runs through brackets and applies controlled force to guide tooth movement.
archwire.exampleUsage: The orthodontist checked the archwire at the visit.

dental-wax.definition: A soft wax used to cover rough parts of braces or other dental appliances to reduce irritation.
dental-wax.exampleUsage: The patient placed dental wax over an irritating bracket edge.

toothbrush.definition: A small brush used with toothpaste to clean your teeth.

toothpaste.definition: A soft substance put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth.

floss.definition: To clean between teeth using a thin thread or strip.

mouthwash.definition: A liquid used to rinse the mouth and help keep it clean.

tongue-scraper.definition: A hand-held oral-hygiene tool designed to clean the surface of the tongue.
tongue-scraper.exampleUsage: The hygienist showed how a tongue scraper is part of oral hygiene.

water-flosser.definition: An oral-hygiene device that directs a controlled stream of water between teeth and along the gumline.
water-flosser.exampleUsage: The water flosser uses a narrow stream of water for cleaning.

plaque.definition: (pathology) a small abnormal patch on or inside the body.

tartar.definition: A member of the Mongolian people of central Asia who invaded Russia in the 13th century.

cavity.definition: Soft decayed area in a tooth.

electric-toothbrush.definition: A toothbrush whose handle contains a motor that rapidly moves the bristled head.
electric-toothbrush.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «يليكتريك تووثبروش»

dental-pick.definition: A small pointed dental or oral-hygiene tool used to examine or clean specific areas around teeth.
dental-pick.exampleUsage: The professional dental pick was kept on the instrument tray.

oral-irrigator.definition: A device that uses a directed stream of water to clean between teeth and around the gums.
oral-irrigator.exampleUsage: The oral irrigator is another name for a water-flossing device.

antibacterial-rinse.definition: A mouth rinse formulated to reduce certain bacteria in the mouth when used as directed.
antibacterial-rinse.exampleUsage: The dentist advised following the label or professional instructions for the antibacterial rinse.

dental-sealant.definition: A thin protective coating placed by a dental professional on chewing surfaces of teeth to help prevent decay.
dental-sealant.exampleUsage: The dentist applied a dental sealant to the deep grooves of a molar.

disclosing-tablet.definition: A tablet that stains dental plaque temporarily so areas needing more cleaning are easier to see.
disclosing-tablet.exampleUsage: The disclosing tablet made remaining plaque visible for the hygiene lesson.

gum-stimulator.definition: A small oral-care tool designed to gently stimulate or clean along the gumline.
gum-stimulator.exampleUsage: The hygienist demonstrated the gum stimulator during oral-care instruction.

dental-chair.definition: An adjustable treatment chair designed to support a patient during dental care.
dental-chair.exampleUsage: The patient sat in the dental chair.

bib.definition: A protective cloth placed over a patient's chest during dental treatment.

tray.definition: An open receptacle for holding or displaying or serving articles or food.

gloves.definition: The handwear used by fielders in playing baseball.

mask.definition: Activity that tries to conceal something.

goggles.definition: (plural) tight-fitting spectacles worn to protect the eyes.

waiting-room.definition: A room where patients wait before a dental appointment.
waiting-room.exampleUsage: The family waited in the clinic waiting room.

insurance-form.definition: A document used to provide information for insurance coverage, billing, or claims.
insurance-form.exampleUsage: The adult patient completed the insurance form at reception.

appointment-card.definition: A card showing the date and time of a scheduled dental visit.
appointment-card.exampleUsage: The receptionist printed a new appointment card.

panoramic-xray.definition: A wide dental X-ray image that shows the upper and lower jaws, teeth, and nearby structures in one view.
panoramic-xray.exampleUsage: The panoramic X-ray showed the position of the teeth and jaws.

intraoral-camera.definition: An instrument used in dental clinics to take images of the inside of the mouth for diagnostic purposes.
intraoral-camera.exampleUsage: The intraoral camera was used during the activity.

amalgam-separator.definition: A device used in dental clinics to separate amalgam fillings from the tooth.
amalgam-separator.exampleUsage: The amalgam separator was used during the activity.

nitrous-oxide-system.definition: A system used in dental clinics to provide nitrous oxide gas for dental procedures.

dental-compressor.definition: A device used in dental clinics to compress teeth for dental procedures.
dental-compressor.exampleUsage: The dental compressor was used during the activity.

suction-unit.definition: A unit used in dental clinics to suction blood from the gums for dental procedures.

emergency-kit.definition: A container used in dental clinics to store emergency supplies for patients.
